summary: Fixed 4 issues from Greptile's automated PR review: webhook serve body-close ordering and missing size limit, and two StringSliceVar flags that silently split on commas.
reason: Greptile review on PR #1252 flagged: (1) webhook_serve.go deferred r.Body.Close() after io.ReadAll, leaking the connection on read errors; (2) webhook_serve.go had no request body size limit; (3) correlate.go's --tag used StringSliceVar, splitting literal commas in tag text into multiple values; (4) event.go's --label used StringSliceVar but only consumed index 0, silently truncating comma-containing labels. All four were real bugs, fixed before merge.
validated_outcome: go build/vet/test pass; --tag and --label help text confirmed to use stringArray/string types respectively, no longer comma-splitting.
